chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah ibn Abi Khalaf Al-Qummi, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa Al-Yaqtini, from a man, from Fudayl ibn 'Uthman Al-Sayrafi, from one who narrated to him, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When Allah wills goodness for a slave, He places the love of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and the love of his Ziyarah in his heart. And when Allah wills evil for a slave, He places the hatred of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and the hatred of his Ziyarah in his heart.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: How does Allah indicate who will love Imam Al-Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the love for Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) as a primary criterion of divine favor (*al-Khayr*), linking spiritual success directly to emotional attachment and the practice of Ziyarah. In Shia scholarship, this is often viewed as a manifestation of *Tawhid* in love, where affection for the Ahl al-Bayt serves as a tangible sign of one's alignment with God's will, distinguishing the sincere believer from the hypocrite.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Abī Khalaf Al-Qummi, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā Al-Yaqťīni, from someone, from Fuďayl ibn ‘Uthmān Al-Sayrafi, from someone who narrated to him, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

When Allāh wills goodness for a slave, He places the love of Ḥusain (a.s.) and the love of his Ziyārah in his heart. When Allāh wills evil for a slave, He places the hatred of Ḥusain (a.s.) and the hatred of his Ziyārah in his heart.
